'''Docking collars''' were standard [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to ship attachment points, allow two ships to dock together. The [[Alderaanian War Frigate]] ''[[Another Chance]]'' had a standard docking collar located near the [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]] which allowed an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] team aboard a [[GAT-12h]] [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray blastboat]] to board the vessel.
